annotations.title: Compare a device to its peers

description:
Answer 'is MY phone normal?' — rank one device's metric against other
devices of the same model AND against the whole fleet, in one call. Returns
the device's value, its 1-based rank, its percentile, and the cohort
median / mean / min / max for both cohorts.

Prefer this over fetching `device_summary` + `model_summary` and comparing
by hand: it is a single call and gives the percentile directly. The model
cohort is the meaningful one for 'is this device degraded'; the fleet cohort
puts the model itself in context.

device_uid.description: Stable device UUID returned by `devices`, `top_devices` or the share flow.

metric.description: Which battery metric to rank on. One of: 'temperature_c' (mean battery temperature, C), 'max_temperature_c' / 'min_temperature_c' (hottest / coldest ever seen, C), 'battery_level_pct' (mean charge level, 0-100), 'discharge_hours' (hours to drain a full 100% - HIGHER means longer battery life), 'ac_charge_hours' / 'usb_charge_hours' / 'wireless_charge_hours' (hours to charge a full 100% on that source - LOWER means faster charging), 'awake_ratio' (fraction of time awake / screen-on, 0..1), 'snapshot_count' (how much data the device contributed), 'uptime_hours' (longest single uptime between reboots).

name: device_ranking

fleet.description: Rank against every device in the fleet, all models mixed.

cohort_size.description: Number of devices in this cohort that have a value for the metric.

median.description: Cohort median — the fair 'typical' value to compare against.

percentile.description: Fraction of the cohort scoring strictly BELOW this device (0..1). 0.9 means it is higher than 90% of the cohort — whether that is good or bad depends on the metric.

rank.description: 1-based rank of this device within the cohort, 1 = highest value. Null when the device has no value.

value.description: This device's value for the metric. Null when the device has no value recorded.

model_cohort.description: Rank against other devices of the SAME brand + model — the fair like-for-like comparison.

cohort_size.description: Number of devices in this cohort that have a value for the metric.

median.description: Cohort median — the fair 'typical' value to compare against.

percentile.description: Fraction of the cohort scoring strictly BELOW this device (0..1). 0.9 means it is higher than 90% of the cohort — whether that is good or bad depends on the metric.

rank.description: 1-based rank of this device within the cohort, 1 = highest value. Null when the device has no value.

value.description: This device's value for the metric. Null when the device has no value recorded.

url.description: Public BatterySnap page with this device's interactive battery history.
